name: Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide 'Triple Black'
story_html: The Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide 'Triple Black' brings a sleek monochrome finish to a comfortable slip-on built with soft and responsive ReactX foam. A contoured footbed is designed to cradle the foot, while extra room at the toe accommodates various foot widths. Exterior branding is limited to a molded Swoosh on the lateral side. Underfoot, the outsole utilizes a radial traction pattern for multi-surface grip.
